summary: MYR Group Inc. filed an 8-K on May 27, 2026, announcing its acquisition of all shares of Valley Holdings I, Inc. (Valley), a Washington-based electrical contractor, for approximately $328 million, subject to post-closing adjustments. The consideration is cash funded from cash on hand and revolving credit facilities. There are additional contingent payments for key executives based on performance targets. Board recommendation, advisor, and premium were not disclosed. The deal requires regulatory approval and other customary conditions. Watch for regulatory timeline and any counterbids; risk-arb focuses on financing and closing certainty.
